post.title: React / Typescript
post.body:
Co-Founder & CTO Wanted 90% Built B2B SaaS

We are seeking a Technical Co-Founder to take full ownership of the codebase and scale our B2B SaaS platform through launch and beyond.

The Details:

Comp: Equity-based (Co-founder level split)

Location: Remote (US / CAN / UK)

Stage: Pre-revenue, near launch

The Situation: We experienced a massive operational headache, built a working solution, and validated market demand. The platform is 90% completeâ€”we just need a technical leader to audit the architecture, finish the final push to launch, and own tech strategy moving forward.

What We Need:

Full-stack capabilities to jump into an existing codebase and ship code fast.

A builder mindset that prioritizes speed to market over over-engineering.

Location in US, Canada, or UK time zones.

Why Join: Zero ideation purgatory. The runway to market is short, the product is built, and you get a co-founder seat at the table with true equity.

Interested? Send over a brief summary of what you've built and a link to your GitHub or LinkedIn.
